_doc: Machine-readable selector map for the Skill-6 MEETING ROOM operator (06-ghl-install-pages/tools/ghl_meeting_rooms.py). Every target in this file is DEDICATED to Meeting Rooms so no Community/Course selector is reused for a meeting surface. Anchors are recorded in Playwright getBy* notation and translated to agent-browser 0.27.0 `find` / native-eval calls by ghl_ab_executor.py. NO node here has been captured live in this lane: live GoHighLevel writes are out of scope for the builder lane, so every target is `capture-pending` and the D8 gate STOP-and-reports until a real capture run flips it to `locked`.

_status_legend.capture-pending: NOT captured live. D8: NO invented CSS. A REQUIRED capture-pending anchor makes the live operator STOP-and-report. It never becomes a guessed click.
_status_legend.locked: LOCKed by a live capture run for THIS surface (create a scratch room, walk it, record the real anchor + confidence, remove it). Safe to drive.
_status_legend.verified-shared-rail: Confirmed on the shared leadconnector app rail and cited from an existing captured map. Safe to act on.

_exec_legend.auto: ghl_ab_executor: `find <locator> <value> click [--name]`, native-eval .click() fallback on a find miss (default).
_exec_legend.native: Trusted DOM element.click() via eval. REQUIRED for GHL Naive-UI submit/save buttons that report Done without firing the handler.
_exec_legend.scoped-native: Card/row-scoped native eval: locate the object's OWN card by name first, then click a control WITHIN it, so a global first-match can never hit another host's room.

_capture_contract: Flip a target to status:'locked' ONLY by a live capture run: open Meeting Room, create a scratch room owned by the authorized test host, record each real anchor + confidence in this file, read the room back after Save, then remove the scratch room through an explicitly authorized cleanup. Record the capture date and location alias (never a client name).
_capture_pending_reason: WF26 lane: no authorized live GoHighLevel write in this run. Capture is named external activation evidence, not fabricated selectors.
